displayName: UE4 directional cascade shadow projection and filter
description: Pixel pass that reconstructs a receiver from scene depth, selects a Texture2DArray cascade, performs four offset shadow gathers, and writes packed directional-shadow factors.

hashFastPaths.evidence: Verified Remake directional/cascade shadow projection filter; it is a receiver-side shadow-map filter, not the directional-light BRDF evaluator.

checks.meaning: The verified projection pass executes with early depth/stencil enabled.
A small volume input supplies the verified per-pixel cascade-filter rotation or jitter.
One screen Texture2D supplies receiver depth.
A Texture2DArray stores the directional shadow cascades.
Separate depth/noise and shadow-array samplers are declared.
Receiver coordinates are reconstructed from the current pixel position.
The receiver scene depth is sampled once at mip zero.
Four offset Texture2DArray gathers form the verified cascade PCF footprint.
Two filtered shadow factors are packed into output X and Z.
The remaining packed channels retain the verified zero/one constants.

runtimeContract.classificationBoundary: receiver-side shadow projection/filter; not a directional-light evaluator
adapterMustConfirm: shadow Texture2DArray binding and cascade count
runtimeContract.controlSafety: Do not transplant local-light BRDF or contact-ray code here. Any filter change must preserve cascade selection, comparison direction, channel packing, and downstream consumers.
